title: Ritva on Ketubot
text: And these words apply to one who reads Scripture and studies Mishnah, but one who teaches others has no fixed measure. And one who does not read and study, it says in the She’iltot that ten are sufficient for him. However, in the Sefer HaMitzvot of Rabbi Meir of Coucy, of blessed memory, it is written that nowadays we presume that for every Jew we suspend study, since they are all full of commandments like a pomegranate; and there is no Jew who is not involved in Scripture and Mishnah. But for a woman, ten are sufficient.
